title: The 10,000th bird was an orange-tufted spiderhunter, and Peter Kaestner got there first

posts.facebook:
Nine in ten of the world's bird species, seen by one man. He began with his brother in a Baltimore back yard.

In February 2024 Peter Kaestner saw an orange-tufted spiderhunter in the Philippines and became the first birder to record 10,000 species. Guinness World Records profiled him in June 2026. How a boyhood hobby in Baltimore shaped a 36-year diplomatic career, what the evidence says about time spent around birds, and how to start or stretch a list of your own.

Keep a list. A list turns a walk into a search, and a search takes you to places you would never otherwise go.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/explore/peter-kaestner-10000-birds/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
